newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Group forms for Credit Lyonnais HK$1.0 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Group forms for Credit Lyonnais HK$1.0 bln FRCD.

text.p: A group has formed for Credit Lyonnais's HK$1.0 billion floating rate certificates of deposit issue due 2000, bookrunner HSBC Market said.
The three-year issue, which was launched through the bank's Hong Kong branch, was priced at par to float at 32 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 40 basis points.
The issue is rated A3 by Moody's Investors Service and A by IBCA, the European credit rating agency.
Application has been made to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the issue as eligible for its Liquidity Adjustment Facility, or discount window.
Arrangers and bookrunners, with HK$155 million each, are Credit Lyonnais and HSBC Markets.

Co-lead managers are Chase Manhattan Asia, Dresdner Bank's Hong Kong branch, Union Bank of Switzerland's Hong Kong branch and Westdeutsche Landesbank, with HK$80 million each, and Banque Nationale de Paris's Hong Kong branch, Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank's Hong Kong branch, Fuji International Finance (HK) and Oakreed Financial Services, with HK$70 million each.
Manager, with HK$30 million each, are PT Bank Negara Indonesia's Hong Kong branch, Hongkong Chinese Bank and HuaNan Commercial Bank's Hong Kong branch.
Signing is set for April 30. The payment date is on May 5.
